title: stone pet
body:
# Stone Pet

Looking for a friend who never runs away, doesn't need to be fed, and always stays by your side? Meet the **Stone Pet**! This mod adds a simple, cute pet rock companion to your Minecraft world.

### Features
* **Wearable:** You can equip your new **stone pet** directly on your head like a stylish and adorable hat!
* **Easy Crafting:** Crafted from just a single piece of cobblestone right in your 2x2 survival inventory.
* **Custom Creative Tab:** Easily find your buddy in its own dedicated creative inventory tab.
